I tend to explore new apps to get to know about different new features. But, honestly, I didn’t find any app better than this. This is an extremely balanced app with all essential features. reviews.review: If it was one time payment I would understand. But to have a subscription model where you force a muslim to either pay monthly or be bombarded with Ads. Dont misinterpret me I dont think what this company is doing is necessarily haram. But it seems you have overreached and made this an app that won’t stop alerting me to things like Qalbox and all the other features.
